_comment: How to remove the owner from a site or index. Only entries checked by hand are here (verified: true); everything else falls back to the JustDeleteMe dataset (downloaded automatically by `leakguard remove status`) or to 'find the privacy contact'. method: email (request drafted from a template) | form (Playwright fills it, submit needs --confirm) | manual (steps + link, the owner does it). Keys are site names lower-cased with non-alphanumerics removed.

twitch.name: Twitch
twitch.steps: Log in to the account, open the link, confirm. (Disabling first gives a grace period; deletion is final.)

instagram.name: Instagram
instagram.steps: Log in, open the link, choose a reason, re-enter the password, confirm. Deletion completes after Instagram's waiting period.

adobe.name: Adobe
adobe.steps: Log in, Privacy and personal data, Delete Adobe account. Cancel paid plans first.

hibp.name: Have I Been Pwned
hibp.steps: Enter the address, open the verification mail HIBP sends, confirm. Hides the address from public searches (the breaches themselves stay).

keysopenpgporg.name: keys.openpgp.org
keysopenpgporg.steps: Enter the address, follow the link mailed to it, unpublish the identity.

pastebin.name: Pastebin
pastebin.steps: Open each paste listed below and use its 'report abuse' link (personal data / credentials).

intelxrecords.name: Intelligence X (record removal)
intelxrecords.steps: Not account deletion: a record removal request to abuse@intelx.io (the address that answers https://intelx.io/abuse requests). Intelligence X removes data only for the address a request comes from (their reply, 2026-11-26), so it is one request per address, sent from that address.

envato.name: Envato
envato.steps: Envato closes accounts only on request to its Customer Success team (no self-service). Send the request from the address registered with the Envato account (otherwise Envato asks extra ownership questions), include the username, and say it is also a personal-data deletion request (GDPR / applicable privacy law). The team's address is not in this catalog: take it from Envato's help centre 'contact' page and set it with `leakguard remove set ID --contact ...`.
